text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and understand text, so they can find the main ideas in a document or answer questions about it. NLP is also used for translation, which means software can change text from one language into another quickly. Another useful function is sentiment analysis: companies use it to discover whether customers feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people online and give helpful answers. Thanks to NLP, we can communicate with machines more easily every day.
